title: Blobs rebuilt in 3D
changes: Every blob, from the little slimes to the Mother Blobs, is now built as a 3D model and drawn as pixel art from the game's camera: real volume, wet glints, and see-through jelly with bones and half-dissolved young floating inside.
Their helmets, halos, spouts, ice spikes, cinders, flames, poison sacs and crowns are now solid parts of the body that turn with it.
No cost to performance: the new art is baked ahead of time at the same size as before.
